doc: UI palette pins (S4b-main T5). GOLDEN-UI class: exact asserted colours/tokens, run-captured on the clean tree at BASE ffa2a2b (Phase 7 Task 1 dark-studio palette, design 2.1; values re-based there, pin contract unchanged). Consumers: tests/test_note_cues.cpp (byte-identical note-fill colours per class + conflict hatch base) and tests/test_focus_resize.cpp (kFocusRing token value + contrast palette-gate input pairs). Geometry (note_rect inputs, band rects, pixel-count gates), WCAG gate thresholds (3.0/4.5), computed ratio comments (hand-derived echo) and treatment inequalities stay in-test with reasons in the task report. kFocusRing duplicates the cues scale-blue token value by design (shared accent); stored once per consumer section for independent reads.
